\title{OpenTeX Compilation Benchmark}
\author{OpenTeX}
\date{}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\section{Purpose}
This document is the fixed target of the OpenTeX compilation benchmark. It is
compiled several times in a row so that the time spent querying MongoDB, the
time spent writing the sources to a temporary directory, and the time spent in
the Tectonic compiler can be measured separately.

\section{Formula}
A short formula keeps the document representative of real LaTeX sources without
making it slow to typeset:

\begin{equation}
    \sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\end{equation}

\end{document}
